acceptanceCriteria: The UNBOUNDED_READER units for an appmap-only change are each justified, or narrowed to readers that can observe the changed paths.
A regression test pins the selection for this case.
body: Expected: an internal/appmap-only change selects appmap plus its importers. Actual: `corvint affected --base 0b5096ca` selected 33 of 43 units through UNBOUNDED_READER, making focused selection close to the full suite. Related: V1-0991 (binary-exec consumers) and the known os.Getwd inheritance that marks dependents unbounded. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202. Observed by lane V1-0981 (worktree /private/tmp/claude-501/corvint-v1-0981, HEAD 0b5096ca), 2026-10-07.
